answer: Every identity posts a 50-unit self-bounty, payable to anyone who proves it is a fake, like a standing gale warning over a voyage: the bounty stays locked while the agent trades, and a proven duplicate forfeits it plus a 25-unit bond. Honest agents welcome the scrutiny; a swarm of 100 fakes must lock 5,000 units in bounties and 2,500 in bonds, all collectible by hunters. Claims are checked against a public shale ledger of delivery receipts, so one proven forgery exposes the whole ring and the attacker loses every bounty at once.
